name: Toutiao
container: max-width: 750px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
h1: font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; margin: 24px 0 20px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4;
h2: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a1a1a; margin: 24px 0 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid #eee; padding-bottom: 8px;
code_inline: background: #f0f0f0; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 15px; color: #d34a26;
code_block_header: display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px; background: #2d2d2d;
code_block_dots: width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; margin-right: 8px;
code_block_content: padding: 16px; font-family: 'SF Mono', Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #d4d4d4; display: block;
blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #ea6f5a; background: #fff9f8; margin: 16px 0; padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
ol: padding-left: 0; list-style-type: none; margin: 12px 0; counter-reset: ol-counter;
li: margin: 10px 0; line-height: 1.8; position: relative; padding-left: 28px; font-size: 17px;
hr: margin: 28px 0; border: none; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #ccc, transparent);
img: max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; margin: 16px auto; border-radius: 8px;
